survivor_toolkit.overview.title: PLAY SMARTER, PLAY FAIR
survivor_toolkit.overview.description: A small collection of client-side tools for survival and building.
survivor_toolkit.overview.privacy: No telemetry, automatic purchases or automated gameplay.
survivor_toolkit.overview.rules: Always check the rules of your server first. Features remain off on remote servers until explicitly permitted.
survivor_toolkit.warden.title: WARDEN ALERT
survivor_toolkit.warden.description: Alerts only when a loaded, visible Warden is in the narrow center of your view and unobstructed. No tracking through walls.
survivor_toolkit.warden.tip: The feature is off by default and needs separate consent on each server.
survivor_toolkit.warden.radius.tip: Cycles the maximum visible distance; it does not reveal hidden entities.
survivor_toolkit.auction.title: MANUAL PRICE CALCULATOR
survivor_toolkit.auction.description: Enter information yourself. This tool does not read auction screens, click, bid or purchase.
survivor_toolkit.auction.tip: Manual analysis only; separately approve each multiplayer server.
survivor_toolkit.auction.locked: Unavailable here until you enable it and confirm this server permits it.
survivor_toolkit.auction.input.tip: Type the value manually. Prices accept a dot or comma.
survivor_toolkit.auction.calculate.tip: Calculate one item and 64 items and save this manually entered offer locally.
survivor_toolkit.auction.error: Check the price and quantity: use non-negative numbers and 1–2304 items.
survivor_toolkit.auction.clear.tip: Removes the locally stored manual price history.
survivor_toolkit.controls.title: KEYS & QUICK BUILD
survivor_toolkit.controls.description: Use Minecraft controls to rebind the menu, freecam, attack and interaction keys. Normal mouse presses and holds remain vanilla.
survivor_toolkit.build.tip: A HUD hint only. The vanilla hotbar highlights its selected slot. No clicks or block placements are generated.
survivor_toolkit.build.description: The selected slot is highlighted by Minecraft. Building, breaking and key holds use the normal game rules.
survivor_toolkit.freecam.title: LOCAL FREECAM
survivor_toolkit.freecam.description: Only available in a private single-player world; LAN and multiplayer are blocked.
survivor_toolkit.freecam.limit: The camera stays in loaded chunks, within 12 blocks and direct line of sight of the player. It cannot pass through walls. Gameplay input is blocked.
survivor_toolkit.freecam.tip: Stand still on the ground and stop using items before enabling. F6 toggles by default.
survivor_toolkit.freecam.local_only: Freecam is only available in a private single-player world.
survivor_toolkit.freecam.stand_still: Stand still on solid ground, dismount and stop using items.
survivor_toolkit.freecam.started: Freecam active · F6 to exit · gameplay actions blocked
survivor_toolkit.settings.title: PREFERENCES
survivor_toolkit.settings.scale.tip: Adjusts the panel and controls; Minecraft GUI Scale also changes text size.
survivor_toolkit.settings.sound.tip: Only a local vanilla UI sound is played.
survivor_toolkit.settings.duration.tip: How long an alert remains on the HUD.
survivor_toolkit.settings.config_locatio: Config: config/survivor-toolkit.json. Key bindings are saved by Minecraft in options.txt.
survivor_toolkit.about.title: ABOUT SURVIVOR TOOLKIT
survivor_toolkit.about.license: MIT license. Uses Minecraft’s built-in font; no bundled third-party artwork.
survivor_toolkit.about.safety: No automated actions, packet manipulation, X-ray or hidden entity tracking.
survivor_toolkit.about.server: For server-side camera access, use explicit administrator permissions or spectator mode instead.
survivor_toolkit.server.unknown: Unknown server address: permission cannot be granted.
survivor_toolkit.server.tip: Each feature requires a separate explicit confirmation for this exact server address.
survivor_toolkit.server.confirm.title: Check server rules
survivor_toolkit.server.confirm.body: I confirm that the rules of %2$s explicitly allow %1$s. This permission applies only to this address.
survivor_toolkit.config.invalid: Invalid config; defaults used. Original file is preserved and saving is disabled.
survivor_toolkit.config.future: Config from a newer version; original preserved and saving disabled.
survivor_toolkit.config.write: Could not save config. Check file permissions.
